summary: Pause the failed nine-image pilot and review prior one-step NEB candidates.

payload.one_executable_step: Keep calculations paused. After the user selects a candidate basis, build only a local reviewable current-endpoint path and run geometry, mapping, magnetic-branch, dist.pl, and nebmovie.pl 0 checks before any submission request.

A local candidate using the current accepted endpoints passes mapping, geometry, reaction-coordinate, fixed-Fe, and visual path review.
